review_findings.finding: Initial real restart row covered representative fields rather than the complete13-ID native catalogue.
review_findings.resolution: New allThirteenStableIdsSurviveRealSaveAndRestartInBothPanes declares distinct two-pane visibility/width/order/sort facts, compares immutable actual submission and stored private DTO, then fresh Window+Bridge restart recaptures both complete pane DTOs including Name width absence and Stretch mode.

checks.fixture_isolation: Only fresh QTemporaryDir private profiles with generated downloads.config/tables.config; no user/profile discovery or live Java startup. Fixture binary values and unknown plugin/root records are in memory literals.
checks.original_preservation: Real save/reload/restart row independently compares original opaque, Table.MyTorrents and Table.UnknownPlugin value encodings; first .bak equals original; second .bak equals previous committed bytes; Reset and restart do not rewrite tables.config. Core byte/order tests separately cover all untouched root slices.
checks.native_capture_and_commit: Actual Save action captures immutable pane DTO before newer local edit; actual Bridge result and reparse verify older capture committed, newer width retained locally with truthful unsaved indication. Reload reads actual committed capture; later Save reuses updated baseline.
checks.identity_and_no_fake_refresh: Session/request checks, stale/missing ack and rejected dispatch cases; actual worker refuses missing read baseline; result emitted while busy, refuses reentrant write/refresh and remains truthful if cancel called from result slot. Snapshot count remains1 across layout and save commands.
checks.window_admission: Native preferences validated before use; source/snapshot ownership required; existing per-pane revision and stillCurrent checks retained; updating_ surrounds apply to suppress hidden detail requests; no selection/filter/pane model mutation in new branch.
checks.window_acks: Acknowledgment never reapplies the submitted layout, uses captured revisions only to label current or newer unsaved edits; a failed/missing result disables Save until reload, pending reload waits for actual save result; close/deletion guards retain known signal boundary behavior.
checks.other_finite_cases: External primary edit refusal leaves external bytes/bak absence/UI widths, unknown future private namespace does not block library open and never permits Save, deleting Window directly from save-request signal is guarded.

limitations: Static source review only; no build/compiler/preprocessor/native/Qt/Java/process/profile execution by reviewer.
11Qt rows are source-planned, not an execution result. Root owns actual command logs/results.
No claim that all original Java table layout choices are shared with native; native preference namespace is separate.
No global OOM, arbitrary custom-model callback, filesystem durability or full-client parity guarantee.
Pure controller and storage/Bridge tests have separate authors/reviews and are not substituted by this integration review.
